narr: The stormy period which began on the 24th continued to bring severe weather and flash flooding through the end of the month.
ev: I-15 was flooded at Bailey Rd.
A flash flood completely buried a vehicle in mud.
Nipton Rd was washed out just east of I-15.
Hwy 190 was impassable in spots between Beatty Junction and Furnace Creek Wash Rd.
Lone Pine Creek flooded Whitney Portal Rd.
More than 50 vehicles were stuck on Hwy 127 due to waist-deep flood waters.
The intersection of Horseshoe Meadows Rd and Lubken Canyon Rd was flooded.
Flooding washed large rocks onto Hwy 168.
Kelbaker Rd was flooded and severely damaged.
Water and mud flowed over I-15.
A woman and two dogs were stuck in flood waters.
Hwy 95 was flooded just north of I-40.
All roads into, out of, and through the Mojave National Preserve were closed due to widespread flood damage.
Water and debris flowed over Horseshoe Meadows Rd.
Flash flooding stranded a train and closed numerous roads.
Hwy 127 was flooded with lots of rocks and debris in the road, and one vehicle was stuck in the water.
Yates Well Rd was flooded five feet deep near I-15.
